Column.title: Column
Column.description:
A column in a Kumo table.

``multicategorical_delimiter`` records how a scalar string
multi-categorical column was split when its metadata was inferred. Kumo
persists this value in the table definition so every later validation,
snapshot, and training operation uses the same interpretation. It may be
a comma (``,``), pipe (``|``), semicolon (``;``), or tab (``\t``).

Resolved scalar string multi-categorical columns must carry this proof.
Only the pre-inference :class:`ColumnMetadataRequest` may defer it. Native
list-valued multi-categorical columns are already structurally separated
and therefore do not use a delimiter. Columns with another semantic type
cannot specify one either.

can be incomplete in its stype, dtype, or timestamp format.

CustomSQLSourceTable.title: CustomSQLSourceTable
CustomSQLSourceTable.description:
A source table whose rows are produced by a read-only SELECT that runs
in the customer's data warehouse.

The query is pushed down and executed unchanged; only its result set is
ingested. As the query has no underlying physical table, ``table``
carries a stable synthetic identifier that downstream cache, staging, and
data-versioning pipelines key on.

``connector_type`` and ``referenced_tables`` are server-owned. The server
derives ``connector_type`` from ``connector_id`` (recording which
warehouse backs the query --
snowflake/databricks/bigquery -- so the persisted def is self-describing;
file-based connectors are rejected) and parses ``referenced_tables`` from
``sql`` (the external tables the query reads, used for lineage and change
detection). Unresolved requests omit both fields; resolved definitions
carry the authoritative values through later lifecycle operations.

DatabricksPredictionTableSource.title: DatabricksPredictionTableSource
DatabricksPredictionTableSource.description:
Custom prediction data read through a project-owned Databricks
connector.

Exactly one of ``table`` or ``sql`` identifies the source. SQL must be a
read-only query; the server validates its catalog/schema scope.

DatabricksSourceTable.title: DatabricksSourceTable
DatabricksSourceTable.description: A source table located in the Databricks data warehouse.

Datetime.title: Datetime
Datetime.description:
A :class:`Datetime` encoder encodes a date or time value, representing
it with various user-specified granularities.

Dtype.title: Dtype
Dtype.description:
The data type of a column.

A data type represents how the data of a column is physically stored. Data
types can be passed to methods in the SDK as strings (*e.g.* ``"int"``).

Attributes:
    bool: A boolean column.
    int: An integer column.
    float: An floating-point column.
    date: A column holding a date.
    time: A column holding a timestamp.
    floatlist: A column holding a list of floating-point values.
    intlist: A column holding a list of integers.
    binary: A column containing binary data.
    stringlist: A column containing list of strings.

EditableField.title: EditableField
EditableField.description:
A single part of the query that may be edited. Corresponds to a single
substring of the entire query.

Args:
    field_name: Name of the field that can be used in user-facing
        messages, e.g. 'entity filter'.
    text: The substring of the query that corresponds to this field.
    position:  Position in the full query, given as a
        (start, end) tuple. When inserting user edits,
        `query.text[position[0]:position[1]]` will be dropped and replaced
        with text, defined by `full_filter_format_string` (if user input is
        non-empty) and `empty_filter_default` otherwise.
    full_filter_format_string: Format string that defines how the
        user-input is inserted into the entire filter.
    empty_filter_default: Default value to insert when the user
        input is empty (no filter).
    bold_text_position: Position in `query.text` to be
        displayed in bold text.

EditableQuery.title: EditableQuery
EditableQuery.description:
Dataclass with the batch prediction query as string and a list of its
fields that may be edited before the BP. Note that `text` might not be the
same as the original query when dealing with, e.g. link prediction target
filters. `validation_response` contains warnings and errors related to the
rewriting - a warning if rewriting took place, an error if MAX_N_CONDITIONS
were exceeded.

        the entity-level XAI files.
    orig_mappings (Optional[Dict[str, List[Union[str, int]]]]): Mappings of
        selection strategy/category and corresponding original
        entity primary keys. None means original IDs were not recorded.

Similar to api.GraphResource, but also includes
timestamps.

Hash.title: Hash
Hash.description:
A :class:`Hash` encoder encodes its corresponding categorical column
by hashing each value to range :obj:`[0..num_components]`, and using this
hashed value to determine the corresponding embedding (with size
:obj:`channels` from the model plan).

Image.title: Image
Image.description: A :class:`Image` encoder is used to process image URLs.

Index.title: Index
Index.description:
An :class:`Index` encoder encodes its corresponding categorical column
by assigning each unique value with frequency above :obj:`min_occ` to an
embedding of size :obj:`channels` from the model plan. Values below this
frequency are all collapsed to the same embedding.

LinkPredOutputType.title: LinkPredOutputType
LinkPredOutputType.description:
Concrete link-prediction module to use.

.. note::
   Embeddings (``return_embeddings=True``) are fully supported only for
   ``SHALLOW_RHS`` and ``TWO_TOWER``. ``CONTEXT`` produces embeddings that
   do not perfectly align with the predicted ranking, and ``PAIRWISE``
   does not support embedding output at all.

ListResponse.title: ListResponse
ListResponse.description:
A config object containing graph or table template metadata.
Used as response for endpoint that lists graph/table templates.
Currently medata includes alias (name), id, timestamps,
source table name, and connector ID.

MaxLogNumerical.title: MaxLogNumerical
MaxLogNumerical.description:
A :class:`MaxLogNumerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column, after applying the transformation

.. math::
    \log \left( \frac{\text{feature} - (\text{min} - 1)}{1.0} \right)

and using a strategy for null value imputation specified by
:obj:`na_strategy`.

MinLogNumerical.title: MinLogNumerical
MinLogNumerical.description:
A :class:`MinLogNumerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column, after applying the transformation

.. math::
    \log \left( \frac{\text{feature} - (\text{max} + 1)}{-1.0} \right)

and using a strategy for null value imputation specified by
:obj:`na_strategy`.

ModelPlanResponse.title: ModelPlanResponse
ModelPlanResponse.description: Response object for suggesting a model plan.

MultiCategorical.title: MultiCategorical
MultiCategorical.description:
A :class:`MultiCategorical` encoder encodes its corresponding
multicategorical column by treating each categorical value independently,
and fusing the results.

Null.title: Null
Null.description: A :class:`Null` encoder skips encoding its corresponding column.

Numerical.title: Numerical
Numerical.description:
A :class:`Numerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column with a normalization specified by :obj:`scaler` and strategy for
null value imputation specified by :obj:`na_strategy`.

NumericalList.title: NumericalList
NumericalList.description:
A :class:`NumericalList` encoder encodes numerical sequences by
treating these sequences as input features with a normalization specified
by :obj:`scaler`.

OutputArtifactStats.title: OutputArtifactStats
OutputArtifactStats.description: Information about each output artifact from the batch prediction job.

PQueryEncodersResponse.title: PQueryEncodersResponse
PQueryEncodersResponse.description:
Response object for the encoders used by a predictive query.

Attributes:
    encoders (Dict[str, str]): A mapping from fully qualified table name to
        encoder representation.

PQueryMetadataResponse.title: PQueryMetadataResponse
PQueryMetadataResponse.description:
Response object describing the task and query type of a predictive query.

Attributes:
    task_type (TaskType): The task type parsed from the predictive query.
    query_type (QueryType): The query type parsed from the predictive
        query.

PQueryResource.title: PQueryResource
PQueryResource.description:
Kumo-private predictive-query resource definition.

The public API owns the strict four-field ``api.PQueryResource`` wire
contract. Private Kumo routes use this strict superset for UI and internal
execution metadata that must never cross the public boundary.

PQueryResponse.title: PQueryResponse
PQueryResponse.description:
Predictive Query resource definition.

Attributes:
    name (Optional[str]): The name of the predictive query. This is an
        optional attribute.
    query_string (str): The query string used for the predictive query.
    graph (GraphDefinition): The graph definition associated with the
        predictive query.
    desc (str): A description of the predictive query. Defaults to an
        empty string.

PredictiveQueryLink.title: PredictiveQueryLink
PredictiveQueryLink.description:
PredictiveQueryLink contains information needed to render a URL to a
predictive query.

QueryType.title: QueryType
QueryType.description: Defines the type of a predictive query.

RHSEmbeddingMode.title: RHSEmbeddingMode
RHSEmbeddingMode.description:
Specifies how to incorporate shallow RHS representations in link
prediction tasks.

RunMode.title: RunMode
RunMode.description:
Defines the run mode for AutoML. Please see the
`Kumo documentation <https://docs.kumo.ai/docs/whats-the-recommended-way-to-cut-down-on-model-training-time>`_

S3PredictionTableSource.title: S3PredictionTableSource
S3PredictionTableSource.description:
Custom prediction data behind one project-owned S3 connector.

Servers enforce relative coordinates only with rooted connectors and full
URIs only with any-URI connectors. The connector supplies all identity and
authorization context; this value contains no credentials.

S3RelativeSource.title: S3RelativeSource
S3RelativeSource.description: A table path beneath a rooted S3 connector target.

S3SourceTable.title: S3SourceTable
S3SourceTable.description:
An S3 table with an explicit rooted-relative or any-URI source.

Servers enforce ``S3RelativeSource`` only with rooted connectors and
``S3URISource`` only with any-URI connectors.

S3URISource.title: S3URISource
S3URISource.description: A canonical full S3 URI used by an any-URI connector.

SnowflakeSourceTable.title: SnowflakeSourceTable
SnowflakeSourceTable.description: A source table located in the Snowflake data warehouse.

SqlTableResolveRequest.title: SqlTableResolveRequest
SqlTableResolveRequest.description: Resolve a Custom SQL source and optional column and role hints.

SqlTableResolveResponse.title: SqlTableResolveResponse
SqlTableResolveResponse.description:
A resolved table definition or validation errors, with a bounded
preview.

Stype.title: Stype
Stype.description:
The semantic type of a column.

A semantic type denotes the semantic meaning of a column, and determines
the preprocessing that is applied to the column. Semantic types can be
passed to methods in the SDK as strings (*e.g.* ``"numerical"``).

.. note::

    For more information about how to select a semantic type, please
    refer to https://docs.kumo.ai/docs/column-preprocessing.

Attributes:
    numerical: A numerical column. Typically integers or floats.
    categorical: A categorical column. Typically boolean or string values
        typically a single token in length.
    multicategorical: A multi-categorical column. Typically a concatenation
        of multiple categories under a single string representation.
    ID: A column holding IDs. Typically numerical values used to uniquely
        identify different entities.
    text: A text column. String values typically multiple tokens in length,
        where the actual language content of the value has semantic
        meaning.
    timestamp: A date/time column.
    sequence: A column holding sequences/embeddings. Consists of lists of
        floats, all of equal length, and are typically the output of
        another AI model
    image: A column holding image URLs.

Subgraph.title: Subgraph
Subgraph.description:
Represents a subgraph with the structure and feature columns.

Args:
    subgraph_store (SubgraphStore, optional): The subgraph store, which
        mainly stores the subgraph structure.
    feature_store (FeatureStore, optional): The subgraph feature store,
        which stores the features for each node.

SubgraphFeatureStore.title: SubgraphFeatureStore
SubgraphFeatureStore.description:
Stores the feature columns records for column for
each node in the subgraph.

Args:
    features (Dict[int, Dict[str, Feature]], optional): Dictionary
        of feature columns for each node, where key for each node
        is the column name and the value is the feature column.

SubgraphNode.title: SubgraphNode
SubgraphNode.description:
Represents a node in the subgraph.

Args:
    id (int): The unique integer ID of the node.
    pkey_name (str, optional): The name of the primary key column.
    pkey (Any, optional): The value of the primary key.

SubgraphStore.title: SubgraphStore
SubgraphStore.description:
Stores the subgraph structure, including the ID for entity (root)
node, nodes and edges. The nodes are stored in a dictionary with the
node ID as the key. The edges are stored in a dictionary with the source
node ID as the key and a dictionary of relation types to a list of
destination node IDs. The tables for each node are stored in a dictionary
with the table name as the key.

Args:
    root_id (int): The ID of the root node.
    task_type (TaskType): The type of the task.
    seed_time (datetime, optional): The seed time of the subgraph.
    nodes (Dict[int, Union[SubgraphNode, AggregatedNodes]], optional):
        The nodes in the subgraph.
    edges (Dict[int, Dict[str, List[int]]], optional): The edges in
        the subgraph, where the key is the source node ID and the value
        is a dictionary of relation types to a list of destination node
        IDs.
    tables (Dict[str, List[int]], optional): The list of node IDs
        for each table.

SuggestModelPlanRequest.title: SuggestModelPlanRequest
SuggestModelPlanRequest.description:
A request to infer model plan based on `query_string`,
`graph_id` , `run_mode`, and optionally `train_table_spec`
if the original training table has been modified.

TableKind.title: TableKind
TableKind.description:
Wire discriminator telling the UI whether a table's rows come from a
physical warehouse/file source (``RAW``) or from a user-defined read-only
Custom SQL ``SELECT`` (``SQL``).

The string values match the UI ``TableKind`` enum
(``ui/src/types/tables.ts``) exactly, so the Tables-list "Kind" filter and
the detail card classify SQL tables straight off the wire.

TableMetadataRequest.title: TableMetadataRequest
TableMetadataRequest.description: A request to infer Kumo table metadata.

TableMetadataResponse.title: TableMetadataResponse
TableMetadataResponse.description: A response containing metadata for a Kumo table.

TableResourceResponse.title: TableResourceResponse
TableResourceResponse.description:
A config object containing table template metadata.
Used as response for `get_table_v2`.

TextEmbedding.title: TextEmbedding
TextEmbedding.description:
A :class:`TextEmbedding` encoder embeds text with a word-embedding
model registered under :obj:`model` in the embedding model store passed
to the trainer. ``"glove.6B-50d"`` is the default model.

TimestampUnit.title: TimestampUnit
TimestampUnit.description: A timestamp unit for a column in a Kumo table.

TrainingTableSpec.title: TrainingTableSpec
TrainingTableSpec.description:
Specifies the modifications made
to a training table generated from a predictive query.

Args:
    weight_col: Weight column used for loss computation.
    split_col: Column holding each row's split assignment, valued
        ``0`` for train, ``1`` for validation and ``2`` for test. The
        column is read out of the supplied table by name, routes the row,
        and is dropped from the seed output. ``None`` leaves the split to
        the generation plan.

UnavailableSourceTable.title: UnavailableSourceTable
UnavailableSourceTable.description:
A source table not available during processing, e.g. because it is
processed by client-side.

ValidationInfo.title: ValidationInfo
ValidationInfo.description:
Represents non-critical information about automatic actions or decisions
taken by Kumo that the user should be aware of, but do not require
immediate attention or action.

WeightMode.title: WeightMode
WeightMode.description:
Specifies how to deal with imbalanced datasets or training tables that
contain a weight column.

WorkflowExecutionStatus.title: WorkflowExecutionStatus
WorkflowExecutionStatus.description:
Status of a workflow execution.

See :py:class:`temporalio.api.enums.v1.WorkflowExecutionStatus`.
